3873.name: Burrow Worm

3916.name: Saffron

3917.name: Leafkin Frond

3925.name: Tanzanite Jewel
desc: A brightly glistening azure jewel.

desc: A rough-cut log of urunday timber.

3927.name: Urunday Lumber
desc: Processed urunday lumber.

3928.name: Velkk Necklace
desc:
A necklace fashioned from bone and worn by the Velkk. 
It is too ominous an accessory to be worn even by adventurers.

3929.name: Velkk Mask
desc:
A mask crafted from leather and worn by the Velkk. 
It is too ominous an accessory to be worn even by adventurers.

3930.name: Twitherym Wing
desc: Despite its near-invisible size, this twitherym wing is a beauty to behold.

3931.name: Twitherym Scale
desc: A single scale painstakingly removed from a tiny twitherym wing. It shines so faintly that it is almost imperceptible.

3932.name: Chapuli Horn
desc: A chapuli horn so razor-sharp that it can slice fingers if handled improperly.

3933.name: Craklaw Pincer
desc: A nearly indestructible pincer ripped from the arm of a craklaw.

3934.name: Matamata Shell
desc: A hollow shell that once served as a suit of armor for a ferocious matamata. It has taken its fair share of beatings, but is none the worse for the wear.

3935.name: Umbril Ooze
desc: A jar of viscous liquid obtained from a slain umbril.

3936.name: Acuex Poison
desc: A jar of viscous liquid obtained from a slain acuex.

3937.name: Panopt Tears
desc: A bottle of brackish tears collected from a culled panopt.

3938.name: Mantid Foreleg
desc: A foreleg from a mantid that is as sharp as any blade.

3939.name: Mantid Carapace
desc: A sturdy exoskeleton that once kept a vicious mantid safe from the elements and enemies.

3940.name: Carrier Crab Crpc.
desc: A rigid and rocky shell that once housed a carrier crab.

3941.name: Chapuli Wing
desc: This wing torn from the back of a chapuli is as light as a feather and flexible enough to survive tempestuous gales.

3942.name: Loc. Elutriator
desc: An interesting specimen of creature that resembles a chapuli. Though normally associated with death and destruction, this type of beast possesses a certain organ which aids in flushing out poisons.

3943.name: Chapuli Fltchg.
desc:
Chapuli wings that are fitted 
to the nock end of arrow shafts. 
They add to the directional stability 
of arrows in flight.

3944.name: Chapuli Arrowhd.
desc: The striking tips of chapuli wing arrows.

3945.name: Mdr. Bolt Heads
desc: The striking tips of midrium bolts.

3946.name: Mantid Arrowhd.
desc: The striking tips of mantid foreleg arrows.

3947.name: Dmc. Bolt Heads
desc: The striking tips of damascus bolts.

3948.name: Tulfaire Fltchg.
desc:
Tulfaire feathers that are fitted 
to the nock end of arrow shafts. 
They add to the directional stability 
of arrows in flight.

3949.name: Tit. Bolt Heads
desc: The striking tips of titanium bolts.

3950.name: Pulchridopt Wing
desc: The wing of a black twitherym that flutters within the deepest recesses of otherworldly skirmishes. Its breathtaking beauty often causes pioneers to forget themselves and stare into its velvet sheen for minutes on end.

3951.name: Wailing Stone
desc: Cold to the touch, this adumbral stone emits faint, ghoulish screams that pioneers liken to a convocation of the damned.

3952.name: Wailing Stone +1
desc: Cold to the touch, this adumbral stone emits faint, ghoulish screams that pioneers liken to a convocation of the damned.

3953.name: Wailing Stone +2
desc: Cold to the touch, this adumbral stone emits faint, ghoulish screams that pioneers liken to a convocation of the damned.

3954.name: Ghastly Stone
desc: Cold to the touch, this pallid stone is as ghoulishly powerful as it is frigid.

3955.name: Ghastly Stone +1
desc: Cold to the touch, this pallid stone is as ghoulishly powerful as it is frigid.

3956.name: Ghastly Stone +2
desc: Cold to the touch, this pallid stone is as ghoulishly powerful as it is frigid.

3957.name: Coalition Grease
desc: Developed by the Inventors' Coalition, this sorcerous lubricant brings out the true power of certain pieces of equipment.

3958.name: Yahse Humus
desc: This mineral-rich soil taken from the Yahse Hunting Grounds is as nutritious as it is natural.

3959.name: D. Oro. Steak
desc: Meat sliced efficiently from the body of one of the Zoldeff River's tastiest inhabitants--the Delectable Orobon.

3960.name: Celadon Yggrete
desc: This stony hunk of a petrified tree contains flecks of a substance that emits an unsettlingly spectral green glow.

3961.name: Zaffre Yggrete
desc: This stony hunk of a petrified tree contains flecks of a substance that emits an unsettlingly spectral blue glow.

3962.name: Alizarin Yggrete
desc: This stony hunk of a petrified tree contains flecks of a substance that emits an unsettlingly spectral red glow.

3963.name: Midrium Sheet
desc: Midrium forged into a sheet.

3964.name: Rhodium Sheet
desc: Rhodium forged into a sheet.

3965.name: Adoulinian Kelp
desc: A type of seaweed that is often harvested along the shores of the Ulbukan continent.

3966.name: Soul Spectacles
desc: Glasses used in the process of measuring soul pyres.

3967.name: Kupon A-DeII
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for spoils from bosses in Delve.

3968.name: Kupon A-De
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for spoils from notorious monsters in Delve.

3969.name: Kupon A-Sal
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for Salvge +1 armor.

3970.name: Kupon A-Nyz
desc: A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).Tradeable for armor from Nyzul Isle Uncharted Survey.

3971.name: Kupon I-S5
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for rank V simulacra segments.

3972.name: Kupon I-S2
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for rank II simulacra segments.

3973.name: Kupon I-Orche
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for orchestrion sheet music.

3974.name: Airlixir
desc: This mystical and magical solution may be as intangible as the air itself, but it still draws out immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

3975.name: Airlixir +1
desc: This mystical and magical solution may be as intangible as the air itself, but it still draws out immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

3976.name: Airlixir +2
desc: This mystical and magical solution may be as intangible as the air itself, but it still draws out immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

3977.name: Gabbrath Horn
desc: The mafic horn of a culled gabbrath that remains doused in the blood of the countless pioneers unfortunate enough to be impaled upon it.

3978.name: Rockfin Fin
desc: A rigid dorsal fin with a surprisingly clean and soft shape. It once belonged to a rockfin before the beast was fished up from the depths of the unknown.

3979.name: Rockfin Tooth
desc: Sharper than the most finely whetted blade, this rockfin tooth can slice through an unwary pioneer's fingers in an instant.

3980.name: Bztavian Stinger
desc: Once attached to the abdomen of an enraged bztavian, this stinger would make even the winds retreat in fear when thrust.

3981.name: Bztavian Wing
desc: This wing ripped forcefully from the back of a bztavian would cause roaring gales to erupt whenever flapped.

3982.name: Arborscent Seed
desc: That this seed will produce vegetation is known. Where the seed came from, however, is not.

3983.name: Arborfruit Seed
desc: That this seed will spring forth fruit is known. Where the seed came from, however, is not.

3984.name: G. Seed Pouch
desc: A pouch containing the seeds of a golden yellow flower.

3985.name: M. Beetle Saliva
desc: Viscous, noxious drool scraped from the mouth of a massive insect that slobbers uncontrollably. Slathering it on mineral veins attracts antlions.

3986.name: Ch. Tree Sap
desc: A fragrant fluid that releases an odor many insects crave. Placing it in an arboreal grove makes it possible to harvest beetles occasionally.

3988.name: Garden Worm
desc:
A long and lithe slimy slitherer that enriches the soil wherever it tunnels.
Increases the yield of crops from a furrow.

3989.name: Grove Humus
desc:
This humus apparently has no official origin, as scholars have yet to ascertain its native habitat.
Reduces the length of a furrow's grow season.

3990.name: Coalition Humus
desc: This spectacular example of humus was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades. Occasionally produces strange and wondrous harvests.

3991.name: Grove Worm
desc:
A long and lithe slimy slitherer that enriches the soil wherever it tunnels.
Increases the bounty obtained from a grove.

3992.name: Grove Mulch
desc:
This specialized mulch works even in the unforgiving Ulbukan soil, keeping the trees growing straight and strong.
Occasionally increases the number of times one can log a grove.

3993.name: Grove Cuttings
desc:
Cuttings from trees nestled in an unspecified forest somewhere in Vana'diel.
Enables lumber to be more easily procured from groves.

3994.name: Entisyrup
desc:
This thick and viscous nectar emits an aroma so enticing that many pioneers begin to slaver simply at the thought of tasting it.
Allows insects to be more easily procured from groves.

3995.name: Coalit. Fertilizer
desc:
This spectacular example of fertilizer was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous finds to flourish in a grove.

3996.name: Stone Serum
desc:
A solution that magically softens the surface of mineral veins and primes them for mining.
Increases the yield of a vein when mined.

3997.name: Vein Serum
desc:
A solution that magically stiffens the surface of mineral veins, which keeps them from degrading quickly.
Occasionally increases the number of times a vein can be mined.

3998.name: Auserum
desc:
A solution that transmogrifies the surface of mineral veins, completely changing their composition.
Allows for precious metals to be more easily procured while mining.

3999.name: Smelting Serum
desc:
A solution that transmogrifies the surface of mineral veins, completely changing their composition.
Allows for metals to be more easily procured while mining.

4000.name: Coalition Serum
desc:
This spectacular example of a serum was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous finds to flourish when mining.

4001.name: Sardine Sphere
desc: A ball of ground sardine mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

4002.name: Bass Sphere
desc: A ball of ground bass mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

4003.name: Shrimp Sphere
desc: A ball of ground shrimp mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

4004.name: Baitball
desc: A ball of ground mincemeat mixed with grains specifically added to attract fish inhabiting freshwater lakes and ponds.

4005.name: Super Baitball
desc:
This spectacular example of rolled bait was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous catches when fishing in freshwater.

4006.name: Sardine Chum
desc: A sack of mangled sardine mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

4007.name: Bass Chum
desc: A sack of mangled bass mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

4008.name: Shrimp Chum
desc: A sack of mangled shrimp mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

4009.name: Mincemeat Chum
desc: A sack of mincemeat slapped together and mixed with grains specifically added to attract saltwater fish.

4010.name: Coalition Chum
desc:
This spectacular example of chum was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Occasionally allows for strange and wondrous catches when fishing in saltwater.

4011.name: Grow-M-Good
desc:
This spectacular example of a catalytic enzyme was released upon Ulbuka by the Inventors' Coalition after months of careful research, which have paid off in spades.
Makes crops harvestable in almost no time.

4012.name: Waktza Rostrum
desc: Though this beak was already torn violently from the head of a conquered waktza, lightning still crackles and darts around it, temporarily paralyzing any who dare to touch its dagger-blade surface.

4013.name: Waktza Crest
desc: Once crowning the head of a proud waktza, this delicately soft feather belies the ferocity of its former master. Due to its difficulty to obtain, many fortunate enough to get their hands upon one employ it as a good luck charm.

4014.name: Yggdreant Bole
desc: This sturdy trunk hacked free of a yggdreant after a flurry of agonizing attempts puts the fear of the forest into each and every pioneer who dares steal even a glimpse at it.

4015.name: Yggdreant Root
desc: This knotted and gnarled root, chopped from the base of a fallen yggdreant, is rumored to bestow everlasting life upon those who boil it in their tea.

4016.name: Tulfaire Feather
desc: A tulfaire pinion feather.

4017.name: Mand. Sprout
desc: The verdant, two-leafed shoot that emerges from the heads of all mandragoras. Contemporary researchers proffer that its leaves capture sunlight and convert it into a sort of nourishment.

4018.name: Guatambu Log
desc: A rough-cut log of guatambu timber.

4019.name: Gua. Lumber
desc: Processed guatambu lumber.

4020.name: Titanium Ore
desc: This ore contains the metal titanium.

4021.name: Titanium Ingot
desc: An ingot of smelted titanium.

4022.name: Titanium Sheet
desc: Titanium forged into a sheet.

4023.name: Snowsteel Ore
desc: This ore contains the precious metal snowsteel.

4024.name: Snowsteel
desc: A refined mass of snowsteel.

4025.name: Snowsteel Sheet
desc: Snowsteel forged into a sheet.

4026.name: Akaso
desc:
A grass common throughout the Ulbukan continent.
Fiber taken from its stem is used as
a material for akaso thread.

4027.name: Akaso Thread
desc: Thread spun from akaso fiber.

4028.name: Akaso Cloth
desc: Cloth woven from akaso fiber thread.

4029.name: Runeweave
desc: This jet-black cloth contains the faintest remains of runic sorcery woven into its fabric.

4030.name: Sekishitsu
desc: Originating from a country in the Far East, this blood red and pitch black coating, made from the sap of the lacquer tree, is often used on wooden crafts.

4031.name: Snap. Secretion
desc: The digestive juices that rest inside a snapweed's mouth and trap whatever prey is unfortunate enough to wander inside.

4032.name: Snap. Tendril
desc: The still-twitching and vine-like limb of a snapweed.

4033.name: Verdigris St.
desc: Cold to the touch, this sickly green stone is as ghoulishly powerful as it is frigid.

4034.name: Verdigris St. +1
desc: Cold to the touch, this sickly green stone is as ghoulishly powerful as it is frigid.

4035.name: Verdigris St. +2
desc: Cold to the touch, this sickly green stone is as ghoulishly powerful as it is frigid.

4036.name: Lebondopt Wing
desc: The wing of a black twitherym that flutters within the deepest recesses of otherworldly skirmishes. Its inconceivably dark color often reminds pioneers how pathetically miniscule they are in the grand scheme of things.

4037.name: Yorcia Visage I
desc: A head segment of a weathered and cryptic simulacrum found lying amidst the wilderness of Eastern Ulbuka.

4038.name: Yorcia Visage II
desc: A head segment of a weathered and cryptic simulacrum found lying amidst the wilderness of Eastern Ulbuka.

4039.name: Yorcia Visage III
desc: A head segment of a weathered and cryptic simulacrum found lying amidst the wilderness of Eastern Ulbuka.

4040.name: Yorcia Visage IV
desc: A head segment of a weathered and cryptic simulacrum found lying amidst the wilderness of Eastern Ulbuka.

4041.name: Yorcia Visage V
desc: A head segment of a weathered and cryptic simulacrum found lying amidst the wilderness of Eastern Ulbuka.

4042.name: Acuex Ore
desc: This ore developed incalculable veins of enigmatic sorcerous minerals while gestating in the stomach of an acuex.

4043.name: Lavarion
desc: A resplendent jewel streaked with slowly snaking lines of magma.

4044.name: Atramenterrane
desc: Its inky slick appearance and metallic lustre are but two clues to the subterranean powers this rock harbors, such as mitigating the forces of water.

4045.name: Cyclone Cotton
desc: Forcefully shorn from its stem by tempestuous winds that churn with the power of the heavens, this bulb of cotton came from locales unknown.

4046.name: Corroded Ore
desc: Dyed a bleeding red hue from various chemical reactions, this craggy and porous mass of minerals has an appearance so miserable that not even a miner could commiserate with it.

4047.name: Rdt. Silk Thread
desc: An extremely strong and incredibly durable thread of silk harvested from erucas that slink about the crevasses of Yorcia Weald.

4048.name: Dragoneye
desc: Speckled with bumps around its eyes, this fish can be found in the rivers and lakes of the Ulbukan continent's archipelago. Many marine life maniacs, including the Green Thumb Moogle, covet this precious fish.

4049.name: Rusted Coin
desc: An ancient piece of currency from the east, hauled in from the depths of the ocean and coated with a heavy layer of rust. Coin collectors like the Green Thumb Moogle may find this of interest.

4050.name: Fat Burrow Worm
desc: So rotund that it would hardly fit in a Meeble's mouth, this rare specimen of burrow worm is prized by not only the burrow diggers themselves, but by the Green Thumb Moogle as well.

4051.name: Alloy Tonic
desc: This mystical solution is inexplicably absorbed by myriad metals, which seems to be how it draws out the immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

4052.name: Alloy Tonic +1
desc: This mystical solution is inexplicably absorbed by myriad metals, which seems to be how it draws out the immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

4053.name: Alloy Tonic +2
desc: This mystical solution is inexplicably absorbed by myriad metals, which seems to be how it draws out the immense powers that lay dormant within certain pieces of equipment.

4054.name: Beetle Spirit
desc: The crystallized soul of a beetle as black as midnight. It squirms so incessantly within its mineral prison that it emits a palpable warmth.

4055.name: Antlion Spirit
desc: The crystallized soul of an antlion as black as midnight. It squirms so incessantly within its mineral prison that it emits a palpable warmth.

4056.name: Pachy. Spirit
desc: The crystallized soul of a pachypodium as black as midnight. It squirms so incessantly within its mineral prison that it emits a palpable warmth.

4057.name: Gelid Aggregate
desc: A frigid crystalline mass, stones of this type occasionally contain pellucid gems that create dazzling displays of light.

4058.name: Bismuth Ore
desc: Dizzying numbers of veins containing the mineral bismuth crisscross the interior of this ore.

4059.name: Pluton
desc: This naturally annealed conglomeration was formed from magma that once coursed through deep subterranean channels.

4060.name: Beitetsu
desc: This somber hunk of ore contains an extremely rare type of iron that rumors say will revolutionize the smithing process.

4061.name: Riftborn Boulder
desc: A shiny, jet-black gemstone wrested from the abyssal depths of an unexplored crevasse.

4062.name: Microcosmic Orb
desc: A gem so solid that dropping it from a fair height supposedly leaves fissures in the immediate area.

4063.name: Macrocosmic Orb
desc: A gem so solid that dropping it from a fair height supposedly leaves fissures in the earth for malms.

4064.name: Rem's Tale Ch.1
desc: The first chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. The kingdom is fraught with chaos, as a long-ruling king collapses. His death engenders a terrible power struggle, from which Rem miraculously emerges the victor.

4065.name: Rem's Tale Ch.2
desc: The second chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the leader of a neighboring empire takes advantage of Rem's inexperience and invades his homeland.

4066.name: Rem's Tale Ch.3
desc: The third chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, Rem's kingdom is unceremoniously routed by the invaders and annexed to their territory.

4067.name: Rem's Tale Ch.4
desc: The fourth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, Rem is stripped of his crown and imprisoned within his own palace's oubliette.

4068.name: Rem's Tale Ch.5
desc: The fifth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the protagonist struggles to maintain his sanity while locked in what is ostensibly a granite-lined hole for a full decade.

4069.name: Rem's Tale Ch.6
desc: The sixth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, a rowdy band of vagabonds who long for the good old days of Rem's rule slips into the oubliette under the cover of darkness and saves him in his eleventh year of imprisonment.

4070.name: Rem's Tale Ch.7
desc: The seventh chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, news of Rem's rescue rings throughout the land and galvanizes the masses to stand up in resistance to the neighboring tyrant.

4071.name: Rem's Tale Ch.8
desc: The eighth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the hefty number of resistance fighters rise up against their oppressive foreign king.

4072.name: Rem's Tale Ch.9
desc: The ninth chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the resistance movement succeeds against all odds. The well-trained phalanxes of infantry from the neighboring kingdom lie battered and defeated outside the castle gates.

4073.name: Rem's Tale Ch.10
desc: The final chapter of ten in the saga of an ordinary man named Rem. In it, the crown is returned to Rem thirteen years after the whole ordeal began. Everyone lives happily ever after under his fair and just rule.

4074.name: Thought Crystal
desc: The crystallized remains of suspended thought memories, they contain a faint trace of life.

4075.name: Hope Crystal
desc: The crystallized remains of suspended hope memories, they contain a faint trace of life.

4076.name: Fulfillment Crystal
desc: The crystallized remains of suspended fulfillment memories, they contain a faint trace of life.

4077.name: Moonbow Steel
desc: This tama-hagane was refined in Reisenjima and shines with seven colors when struck by the moon's light. The technique for refining it has been lost to eternity.

4078.name: Moonbow Cloth
desc: This fabric was woven in Reisenjima and shines with seven colors when struck by the moon's light. The technique for weaving it has been lost to eternity.

4079.name: Moonbow Leather
desc: This leather was made in Reisenjima and shines with seven colors when struck by the moon's light. The technique for making it has been lost to eternity.

4080.name: Moonbow Urushi
desc: This paint was mixed in Reisenjima and shines with seven colors when struck by the moon's light. The technique for mixing it has been lost to eternity.

4081.name: Moonbow Stone
desc: This gem was polished in Reisenjima and shines with seven colors when struck by the moon's light. The technique for polishing it has been lost to eternity.

4082.name: Moonlight Coral
desc: This coral from Reisenjima gives off a warm and soft light.

4083.name: Ber. Arrowheads
desc: The striking tips of beryllium arrows.

4084.name: Mixed Fletchings
desc:
A mixture of porxie wings and
chapuli wings that are fitted
to the nock end of arrow shafts.
They add to the directional stability
of arrows in flight.

4085.name: Ber. Bolt Heads
desc: The striking tips of beryllium bolts.

4086.name: Lustreless Scale
desc: A blackened scale that has long lost its lustre.

4087.name: Lustreless Hide
desc: A blackened hide that has long lost its lustre.

4088.name: Lustreless Wing
desc: A blackened wing that has long lost its lustre.

4089.name: Bonanza Pearl
desc: A Mog Bonanza pearl inscribed with the numbers which you have selected. Issued by the Mog House Management Union.

4090.name: Dream Fl. Petal
desc: A redolent flower petal. Essential oil extraced from it can be used to enhance one's dreams.

4091.name: BB Cowbell A.
desc: A perfect replica of the cowbells used for Vana'diel's most famous buffaloes. Collect all three types and bring them to Jeuno for a special reward.

4092.name: BB Cowbell B.
desc: A perfect replica of the cowbells used for Vana'diel's most famous buffaloes. Collect all three types and bring them to Jeuno for a special reward.

4093.name: BB Cowbell G.
desc: A perfect replica of the cowbells used for Vana'diel's most famous buffaloes. Collect all three types and bring them to Jeuno for a special reward.

4094.name: Goblin Stew 880
desc: The epitome of soups everywhere, this stew was cooked in the year 880. The longer it ages, the better it tastes, but most Goblins cannot bear to leave it sitting for more than a few minutes before their appetites get the best of them.

4095.name: Bismuth Sheet
desc: Bismuth forged into a sheet.
